title: C is for Creation — God Made Everything!
memory_verse: "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth." — Genesis 1:1
objective: Students will learn the letter C and the Bible word Creation, understanding that God made everything.
content: Today we are learning the letter C! Can you say C? C is for Creation!
Creation means everything God made. God made the sky, the sun, the moon, and the stars. God made the trees, the flowers, and the animals. God made you and me!
God made everything in six days, and on the seventh day He rested. Everything God made was very good!
activity: Color a picture of the letter C. Draw your favorite thing that God created — maybe a flower, an animal, or the sun!
discussion: Can you say the letter C?
What is your favorite thing God created?
